name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: We should adopt a 2-pixel solid focus ring with a 2-pixel outer glow at 20% opacity. This decision provides a clear visual indicator for keyboard navigation, which is essential for users who rely on assistive technologies, while also being subtle enough not to overwhelm users with visual distractions. By choosing a 2-pixel focus ring, we're accepting the trade-off of slightly increasing visual clutter, but it's a necessary compromise to ensure that our interface is usable by everyone, particularly those with visual impairments. This design choice also aligns with the Playwright MCP's emphasis on clear and consistent visual cues.

name: Reader
text: The 2px ring + 2px glow bleeds at 125% zoom—it’s not just "slightly less professional," it fails WCAG 1.4.10 (Reflow) at 200% zoom. Use a 1px ring with a 1px glow at 30% opacity instead. Test with Playwright MCP’s keyboard navigation suite and confirm no overlap or loss of focus visibility at 200% zoom.
